title: samantha-lee-devx-sdk-todo-2026-03-07
content:
Daily scratchpad - developer experience / SDK docs (quick notes)
Date: 2026-03-07
Owner: Samantha Lee

Context:
- Follow-up from last pairing with Mikaela on the Python quickstart gaps. Ran through the sample app and found a few blocking UX issues for new users.
- Prioritized list below for next two days; some items can be quick PRs, others need small design/decision.

Top priorities (blocking onboarding):
1) Quickstart README mismatch with SDK v1.3.2
   - Problem: README shows client initialization as `Client(api_key=...)` but SDK switched to `RedwoodClient.from_env()` in v1.3.0. New users hit auth errors.
   - Action: Update README examples to use from_env and add a 1-line fallback snippet for explicit api_key for prod examples.
   - ETA: 2026-03-08 (PR + small test)
   - Linked: PR #342 (see linked_artifacts)

2) Sample app: streaming example is broken in JS variant
   - Symptoms: streaming handler expects `onToken` callback, our code sample uses `onMessage` (typo). Causes confusion in tutorial video.
   - Quick fix: change sample to `onToken` and add note about cancellation API.
   - Test plan: run sample locally + smoke test in CDN-hosted tutorial page.
   - Owner: me, pair with Evan for CI validation.

3) Table of contents for SDK quickstart page (Confluence) missing code snippets for embeddings flow
   - Add minimal end-to-end embedding example (js + python) and a short note on cost/units.
   - Need: sample input, expected vector dims for default model, small note on batching recommendations.

Nice-to-have / lower priority:
- Add 'common errors' subsection with two entries: auth misconfig (above) and rate-limit 429 handling pattern (retry/backoff snippet).
- Add a short section: "When to use hosted vs dedicated" in SDK README linking to product docs (one-liner + link).
- Cross-link troubleshooting to the SDK error codes doc (ENGDOC-512)

Open questions / decisions:
- Should quickstart JS sample default to streaming or non-streaming? Pros: streaming shows lower perceived latency. Cons: slightly more complex callbacks. My recommendation: keep streaming as default but include non-streaming snippet with a single-line note.
- For the embedding example, what default model should we reference? Suggest using `redwood/embedding-small-v1` as a stable low-cost example. Confirm with ML team.

Small PR checklist (for each PR):
- Update README.md + examples in /examples/quickstart/*
- Add unit e2e smoke test that runs examples with mocked network (or small live test using staging key)
- Update Confluence quickstart page with new snippets and screenshots
- Add entry in CHANGELOG.md under "docs" for the SDK release

Immediate todo (today):
- [ ] Open PR to fix README auth example (branch: fix/readme-auth-2026-03-07)
- [ ] Patch JS sample (onToken) and run local tutorial script
- [ ] Draft embedding code snippet for Confluence page and ping ML (Mikaela)
- [ ] Add small note on rate-limit handling to FAQ section

Notes to self/typing reminders:
- Keep examples minimal: <20 lines for each language. Prefer clarity over completeness.
- When referencing API methods use exact names from code (avoid `Client` ambiguity).
- Include command to run sample app locally: `npm run demo` + env var examples.

Slack TODOs / followups:
- @mikaela: confirm embedding default model + dims, pinged in thread #devx-embeddings
- @evan: help validate CI smoke runs for the JS sample (can we add a tiny GH Action that runs node example?)

Rough timeline:
- 2026-03-07: PRs opened for quick fixes (README + JS sample)
- 2026-03-08: land quick fixes + update Confluence
- 2026-03-09: follow up on embedding section and add tests

Backlog ideas (capture here):
- Interactive notebook example (Colab) that demonstrates streaming + embeddings + rerank in one flow (nice for demo day)
- Tiny starter template (create-redwood-sample) that scaffolds a simple chat UI wired to hosted API with environment variable example and basic error handling

End of scratchpad.
